questions: Is OER-OBB a genuinely new orientation-failure method, or merely double-machine-learning residualization applied to known TTA uncertainty features?
Does the proposed cross-fitting and negative-control design actually block aspect-ratio, class, score and detector-family shortcuts?
Do the matched-TP estimand, GT_AR eligibility domain and axial-error outcome introduce a new selection or definition artifact?
Are the Delta_AUGRC floor, 4-of-8 source gate and two-target confirmation rule scientifically justified rather than fitted to r037?
Which strongest same-budget baseline is most likely to dominate OER-OBB, and what is the fairest tuning protocol?
Do two legally usable, scientifically unconsumed target datasets and at least two detector families actually exist on the server?
What is the cheapest source-only experiment whose failure must reject OER-OBB before any new target access or detector training?
If every frozen gate passes, is the resulting contribution sufficient for ISPRS JPRS or TGRS, and what remaining claim or evidence gap would still block that level?
completion_condition: B returns one evidence-backed open attack with ADOPT, REVISE, REJECT or CHEAP_KILL_EXPERIMENT and identifies the strongest alternative explanation, nearest prior-art boundary, cheapest decisive source-only test and realistic JPRS/TGRS gate; no server dispatch, target access, training, download or root dis/sug.md change follows without a revised written L2 specification and new user authorization.
